title: When the Colony Falls Again
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Paloma Sterling, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
